/--

-/
theorem putnam_1999_a5
: ∀ p : Polynomial ℝ, ∃ C : ℝ, p.degree = 1999 → ‖p.eval 0‖ ≤ C * ∫ x in (-1)..1, ‖p.eval x‖ :=
